blocks.heading: What the checks cover
paragraphs: The dedicated workers on Meta's Muse models don't have a health check of their own. Their work shows in the counts of the three Eranos queues on Tessera's health check.
Agents can read this page's answer as JSON at [/api/status](/api/status). When a service asks you to slow down with HTTP 429, wait for its `Retry-After` time.
